Main Questions

Ensure that the class understands the basics of the
Kleisthenic reforms by clearly defining the tribes (phylai),
trittyes, and demes. Explain how the new tribal organization worked
with the council (Boule) and the army.

Should we accept that the objective of Kleisthenes was simply to
strengthen the citizenry of Attike, either by giving the common
people a greater role in the government (as AP 22.2), or by unifying
them in such a way as to de-emphasize traditional regional
allegiances? If not, why not? What other theories have been put
forward to explain the purpose of the Kleisthenic reforms? Which is
most plausible and why?
